hyperponder.ponder.muteki.text_1: Keep the Muteki Star in your hotbar and you become Muteki.
hyperponder.ponder.muteki.text_2: Command selectors such as @e can no longer pick you.
hyperponder.ponder.muteki.text_3: Your items cannot be stolen either.
hyperponder.ponder.muteki.text_4: It also ignores the Novel Calibur's instant kill.
hyperponder.ponder.novel.text_1: Left-click and every entity near your line of sight is defeated.
hyperponder.ponder.novel.text_2: While sneaking, only the single entity you are looking at is defeated.
hyperponder.ponder.novel.text_3: Rare drops, experience orbs and enchantment effects still work.
hyperponder.ponder.novel.text_4: It can also be used as a modifier in Tinkers' Construct.
hyperponder.ponder.chronicle.text_3: The region between them becomes protected.
hyperponder.ponder.chronicle.text_4: Inside, players can only touch things as if they were in Adventure mode.
hyperponder.ponder.chronicle.text_5: By default only the owner can act inside. A paused region blocks even the owner.
hyperponder.ponder.chronicle.text_6: Left-click the region to release the protection.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_1: Left-click a block to mine it instantly.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_2: Right-click a start and an end point to create a combo chain.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_3: Mining a block inside the chain mines the whole chain at once.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_4: Middle-click a chain to make a combo cluster. Sneak and right-click to dissolve it.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_5: Drops go straight into your inventory; otherwise they are stored inside the item.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_6: Throw the item to deliver its contents to the storage you are looking at.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_1: Right-click a block or an entity to open its VRX.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_2: Set the contents in the GUI and close it to give the VRX to the target.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_3: Left-click a block or an entity to dissolve its VRX.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_4: Right-click the player inside the GUI to open your own VRX.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_5: The contents can also be set from JEI or EMI when they are installed.
